name: Purpose Of The Law
overview: The purpose of the law, as revealed in Scripture, is not to abolish God's commands but to fulfill them through Christ (Matthew 5:17). The law exposes sin and defines it, making us aware of our need for salvation (Romans 7:7). However, justification and righteousness come not through the works of the law but by faith in Jesus Christ (Romans 3:28; Galatians 2:16). Believers are no longer under the dominion of the law but live under grace, which empowers them to resist sin without using grace as a license to sin (Romans 6:14-15).
